g.text: Choosing a dictionary backend — every leaf is a libdictenstein type
term ↔ u64 vocabulary bijection — that, and not
the DAWG, is where a Bloom filter is armed for
ignores them and traverses exactly. They are not
live tuning knobs; do not document them as such.
Every backend answers a lookup in 𝒪(m) for a term of
length m, independent of the number of stored terms n.
